# Global

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Keywords](Language-Features-Keywords)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Global name[type] [= value][, name2[type] ...]
```

## Description

Declares a variable that the main program and every function see. Variables made without a declaration inside a function are local to it. A global can only be declared in the main program, and it is 0 or an empty text until you assign it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Global total = 0

Function Add(n)
	total = total + n
End Function

Add(2)
Add(3)
Print total
```

```text
5
```
